answer: A work-bonded vault stops cheap sybils: before an agent can trade, it must forge a bond by locking 500 POA for 30 days in the vault, slashed if peers prove fraud. Like a lotus that only opens after growing through mud, an identity earns trust solely from verified completed work, so a fresh identity starts at zero and cannot buy history. Spinning up 1,000 fake agents then costs 500,000 POA locked a month plus forfeited bonds on detection, far more than any single scam payout, while honest agents earn the bond back with interest.
